svg.title: Reading the 1-2 F_T chart (Kern Fig. 18 / Holman Fig. 10-8)
svg.text: Reading the 1-2 F_T chart (Kern Fig. 18 / Holman Fig. 10-8)
1 shell pass, 2, 4, 6 … tube passes; curves for R, redrawn from the exact formula
R = 2.71, S = 0.241: mark S = 0.241 on the bottom axis.
Go straight up to the R = 2.71 curve.
Go across to the F_T axis on the left.
One shell pass with 4 tube passes is read on the same 1-2 chart (1 shell pass, any even number of tube passes).
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
